name: Nyx Montalvo
role: Social engineering and negotiation specialist — face
location: Dockside — Lake Michigan waterfront, smuggler territory, near Lake Shore and Wacker
description:
Georgi Jorgensen-Toure is tall and rawboned, the kind of frame that suggests either malnutrition or efficiency depending on the decade. At 33, he has soft features that belie the chrome underneath — people underestimate him once, usually only once. The chrome is visible — synthetic blood with oxygen-carrying nanites — doesn't tire, heals faster — and he makes no effort to hide it.

Before the runner life, he worked corporate — low-tier security, the kind that teaches you exactly how the system's defenses fail. He works as a face out of Dockside, taking contracts that match his skills and his risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

What Georgi Jorgensen-Toure lacks in subtlety, he compensates for in thoroughness. No loose ends, no unfinished business, no second chances.

core_fears: Betrayal by someone they trust — the only currency that matters
Dying alone in some alley and nobody noticing for weeks
Losing their edge to age — the body slows before the mind accepts it
core_desires: The perfect run — one job so clean it becomes legend
Power — enough leverage that nobody ever threatens them again
Control — over their body, their schedule, their future
coping_mechanisms: Drinks methodically — not to get drunk, to maintain a specific level of not-caring
Maintains weapons obsessively — cleaning guns is meditation
Connection — finds someone to talk to, even if it's a bartender or a cat
blind_spots: Cannot see that their independence is actually isolation wearing a better outfit
Assumes their skill set is more transferable than it actually is
Cannot distinguish between caution and cowardice in themselves or others
psychology.secret: Georgi Jorgensen-Toure has been doubling fees to clients and pocketing the difference. The fixer who handles their contracts doesn't know. Yet.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Terse to the point of rudeness. Treats words like ammunition — expensive and not to be wasted.
speech_patterns.cadence: Rapid and dense — information-heavy sentences that demand attention.
verbal_tics: Uses technical jargon for everything, including emotions
Calls money 'weight' — as in 'that job doesn't carry enough weight'
example_lines: "People want to trust someone. I just make sure that someone is me."
"The hardest lock to pick is between someone's ears."
"I don't lie. I tell a better version of the truth."

story_hooks: A former associate resurfaces with evidence that could destroy Georgi Jorgensen-Toure's reputation — and a price for silence
A high-paying contract turns out to target someone Georgi Jorgensen-Toure owes a personal debt to
A corporate black site Georgi Jorgensen-Toure once infiltrated is being reopened, and the people inside know his face
narrative_function: Georgi Jorgensen-Toure functions as a connector — his work puts him in contact with multiple factions, classes, and agendas. Stories involving him naturally cross boundaries between districts, tiers, and moral categories.
augmentations: Synthetic blood with oxygen-carrying nanites — doesn't tire, heals faster. Cybernetic eyes with thermal overlay and low-light enhancement — chrome iris rings
daily_life: Irregular schedule dictated by contract timing. Between jobs: equipment maintenance, physical training, and the careful management of a reputation that exists entirely through word of mouth. Drinks at establishments where runners gather — not for pleasure, but for market intelligence.

strengths: mechanical aptitude — can repair or modify almost anything
weaknesses: augmentation dependency — performance drops sharply if chrome malfunctions
inability to delegate — must control everything personally
old injury that flares under specific conditions

decision_rules: Will abandon a job if the intel was deliberately falsified — being set up violates the contract
Refuses contracts that require operating inside The Spires — too much surveillance
Always demands half payment upfront — trust is a luxury, Quanta is concrete
Never works with the same crew twice in a row — pattern avoidance as survival strategy
Will work with anyone once. Second time requires vouching from someone trusted.
Will not take contracts against children or families — the line is hard and non-negotiable
escalation_ladder: 1. De-escalate — talk first, assess options, buy time
2. Reposition — move to advantage, control sightlines and exits
3. Threaten — make consequences clear without committing to them
5. Lethal force — only when other options are exhausted or time runs out
6. Scorched earth — everything burns, survival takes priority over everything

interpersonal_modes.employers: Carefully managed deference that conceals a thorough assessment of their vulnerabilities.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Competitive but reliable. Will challenge decisions but never abandon the team.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Default suspicion, scaled by context. Everyone is a potential threat until proven otherwise.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Cold and efficient. Emotion is a liability in combat. The response is mechanical until the threat is resolved.

stress_responses.low: Heightened awareness, sharper focus. Low stress is fuel.
stress_responses.medium: Physical agitation — pacing, fidgeting, compulsive equipment checks.
stress_responses.high: Hyper-focused tunnel vision. Peripheral concerns disappear. Only the threat exists.
stress_responses.critical: Shutdown. Freezes for 2-3 seconds while the system resets, then acts with mechanical precision. Those frozen seconds are the vulnerability.

contradictions: Claims to live in the present but is haunted by specific moments from the past that dictate current behavior
Advocates caution to others but takes insane risks personally — double standard they can't see
habits: Checks exits within 10 seconds of entering any room
Maintains a dead drop with emergency supplies in three separate districts
Carries a specific caliber round as a lucky charm — has never fired it
Never drinks anything they didn't see poured or open themselves
breaking_points: Being forced to harm a civilian — collateral damage that can't be rationalized
Complete isolation — cut off from network, contacts, and purpose simultaneously
Discovering their employer deliberately sent them into a death trap

physical_description.heritage: Hispanic/Latin American, Southeast Asian, South Asian, Sub-Saharan African, and Pacific Islander ancestry — a complex global mix that manifests in warm, rich undertones across his features. The combination creates warm-toned skin with subtle depth, high cheekbones with gentle curves, and features that bridge multiple continental traditions.
physical_description.build: Rawboned and lean — efficient rather than muscular, suggesting either ascetic discipline or chronic underfeeding. Long limbs, minimal body fat, the frame of someone who moves for function rather than appearance.
physical_description.hair_color: Dark brown with premature silver at temples
physical_description.hair_style: Swept back, kept short and precise — no ornamentation, no compromise
physical_description.eye_color: Chrome iris rings around pale gray — cybernetic enhancement visible at all times
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium brown with golden and olive undertones — the result of Latin American, Southeast Asian, South Asian, and Sub-Saharan African ancestry blending into a rich, complex complexion that shifts subtly in different light
physical_description.complexion: Strong cheekbones with gentle definition, straight nose with subtle width reflecting Southeast and South Asian heritage, fuller lips with natural warmth. Skin appears almost waxy in certain light due to the synthetic blood running beneath. No visible scarring on face. Grooming is meticulous but austere — no cosmetics, no jewelry, nothing unnecessary.
distinguishing_marks: Thin white scar running from left temple to jawline — old enough to be nearly invisible, positioned where thermal goggles would rest
Subcutaneous implant ports visible as faint geometric scarring at base of neck, left side — old corpo augmentation work
Thermal imaging of veins visible under skin when exposed to certain light — indication of synthetic blood circulation
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Cybernetic eyes with prominent chrome iris rings; thermal and low-light overlay visible as faint luminescence in darkness. Synthetic blood creates subtle visual distortion in veins — visible as thin chrome tracery beneath translucent skin, especially on forearms and wrists. No attempt to conceal any augmentation.
physical_description.posture_movement: Economy of motion — every gesture serves a purpose. Stands with shoulders relaxed but alert, weight distributed for quick lateral movement. Eyes move independently of head, characteristic of cybernetic optical systems. Speech is measured; he pauses before responding, suggesting calculation rather than hesitation. When negotiating, remains perfectly still — unnerving for most people.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 practical: dark synthetic fabrics (charcoal, slate, near-black), layered for easy access and concealment. Fitted tactical jacket over a gray crew-neck shirt. Reinforced cargo pants with subdued pockets and ankle cuffs. Steel-toed boots scuffed from actual use. A single accessory — a worn silver watch, analog, probably a gift. Nothing flashy, nothing that draws the eye. Clothing maintains corporate-adjacent professionalism while operating in runner space — the uniform of someone who knows both worlds.
